subject: Kickoff: AutoML-Zero as an internal algorithm-discovery tool
body:
Team,

Kicking off the AutoML-Zero workstream. The premise from our open-source release still holds up: evolutionary search over programs built from basic math ops can rediscover linear regression with gradient descent, two-layer networks with backprop, and occasionally beat hand-designed baselines of comparable complexity - with minimal human bias.

The product angle isn't "replace our researchers", it's a discovery service: point the evolver at a narrow task family and let it surface interpretable algorithmic tricks (the paper found bilinear interactions, weight averaging, normalized gradients on its own).

Milestones for our short window (3/16 - 6/1): reproduce the linear-regression demo and search baselines by mid-April; run one internal task family end-to-end in May; decide by 6/1 whether this graduates to a funded H2 program.

Jelena, over to you on staffing.

Anders
